Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You spit out the dust, bark a laugh and surge to your feet before the enemy has finished enjoying the sight.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, when you stand from Prone.
Duration
Standing cost is always changed; the Boon expires when used or this turn ends.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
The Boon can be gained once on your turn; repeated standing does not stack it.
Type
Signature

Standing costs 1 square of movement instead of 2. After standing on your turn, gain 1 Boon to your next Force action or Main Action melee attack before that turn ends. This grants no ability to stand while movement is prohibited.

Additional rulings
